# Agency Agents preview bundle

The immutable cats-plugins Agency 0.1.0 archive is retained here as a production
Desktop packaging input. Its exact version and SHA-256 are frozen in
`config/desktop-plugins.lock.json`. Preview packaging includes these bytes as an
optional installer source; release packaging excludes them. Bundling never writes
the user's Plugin inventory or selects a Cat skill.

Upstream: https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents at
`479193dcce1cf6432ce0f5aa230ab8cc739a8c6b`. The archive retains the reviewed Code
Reviewer and UX Researcher conversions, original sources, MIT license, notices
and conversion provenance. The adjacent `agency-agents-LICENSE` is also retained.
The archive is 40,832 bytes and is identical to the existing producer test fixture.
